name: USGS Earthquake Agent
description: Read-only agent over the live USGS earthquake catalog: recent earthquakes worldwide by magnitude and time window, quakes inside a radius of a point or known metro area, live catalog counts, and a watch skill that POSTs to your webhook when a new qualifying earthquake is recorded. Every answer is read live from the USGS FDSN event service. This hosted endpoint answers quakes-recent, quakes-near, quakes-summary; the local server additionally implements quakes-watch.

skills.name: Recent earthquakes
skills.description: Earthquakes recorded by the USGS in a time window, worldwide, filtered by minimum magnitude and sorted newest first. Each event carries magnitude, place, depth, tsunami flag, felt reports and the USGS event page URL.
examples: Any earthquakes above magnitude 4.5 in the last 24 hours?

skills.name: Earthquakes near a place
skills.description: Earthquakes within a radius of a latitude/longitude point, or of a known metro area such as Tokyo, Lima, Istanbul or San Francisco. Answers 'has anything shaken near me'.
examples: any quakes near Tokyo this month?

skills.name: Live earthquake counts
skills.description: How much the ground has moved lately: how many quakes the USGS catalogued worldwide in the last 24 hours at magnitude 2.5+ and 4.5+, and in the last 7 days at 6.0+, plus the largest recent event.

metadata.note: The local Python server implements every skill on its own card, including watch loops and push notifications. This hosted card lists only the skills the hosted endpoint answers.
